title: At load, a cloud record that could not be read and a browser that holds no copy: "Use this browser only" forgets the cloud and reloads to an empty record, though the record is untouched in the cloud
evidence: Done 2026-11-13: owner ruled (a), ask first, in his exact sentence. The sign-in state's confirmingExit (widget-src/src/storage/sign-in-state.ts, transition table in sign-in-state.test.ts); 'no copy here' is holdsCopyHere (widget-src/standalone/connect.ts); pinned in reconnect-data-pins.test.tsx (US-09 AC49). Was: A fully saved cloud session leaves no device copy (record-session.ts flushSync returns when nothing is unsaved), so an up-to-date Drive or Dropbox user whose sign-in is dead or whose provider is down at load sees the reconnect panel over an empty tool. The exit's copySessionToDevice flushes the load-time fallback session, whose record is empty because the cloud was never read, then disconnects and reloads: BACKEND_KEY null, the tokens gone, the device record empty, the cloud file unchanged. Pinned as TODAY in widget-src/standalone/reconnect-data-pins.test.tsx (owner question). Recovery: choosing the same cloud in the picker brings the record back intact. PR 1554 fixes the mid-session and fallback-edit cases, not this one. Options for Brad: (a) in exactly this state (cloud not read this session AND no device record) the exit asks first, which needs a sentence from Brad; candidate existing sentences, true here: 'Your record is safe in your {label}.' (sync-control.tsx) and the picker refusal '{label} could not be reached, so your record there could not be copied to this browser. Try again once it answers.' (connect.ts); (b) the exit is not offered in that state; (c) leave as today. Found 2026-11-13
